name: Hard Love
source:
Main character grows a strong distrust for women after losing mother as a result of divorce. But living with a beautiful aunt and younger cousin gradually helps him to open his heart. However, a shocking incident happens that strengthens his distrust again. Protagonist starts to fanatically seek his cousin's love as the only person he can ever trust.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因父母离异而失去母亲，从此对女性产生强烈的不信任。与美丽的姨母和年幼的表妹共同生活，让他逐渐敞开心扉。然而，一场震撼事件再次加深了他的不信任。主角开始疯狂寻求表妹的爱，把她视为世上唯一值得信任的人。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
